description: L070301 - Tratto di linea della rete elettrica (Comune di Milano - DBT 2012 - DATASET) is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoDati - RNDT. Strato informativo del DataBase Topografico - DBT 2012 del Comune di Milano, volo marzo 2012, scala nominale di restituzione 1:1000. Linea elettrica. Coverage: Comune di Milano. The portal files it under the publisher GeoDati - RNDT. Its tags are corrente, database, dbgt, dbt, elettricita. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
